title: fix: give API key PATCH docs a request body
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: The API docs generator now supplies a curated request body for the Update API Key PATCH example. Write-example validation is unchanged. The generated APIDOCS.md passed static validation against the live OpenAPI schema, but the generated file is not included in this PR.
